glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 宀 (“house”) + 口 (“mouth”), echos in a place. The original form of 響. It was borrowed to represent 𠨍 (嚮) later. The mouth does not represent an opening as in 高 and 谷. Compare 冋.
senses: [xiàng] to side with; to favour; to discriminate in favour of
[Xiàng] name of two places in modern Henan
(Teochew) that; in that manner; that much (modifies adjectives)
